description:
Place a real outbound phone call to a US number and have an AI voice agent carry out a task on the user's behalf.

The call is placed immediately, consumes credits, and cannot be recalled once it
connects.

Every call opens with a mandatory AI disclosure: as soon as a human answers, the
agent identifies itself as an AI calling on the user's behalf and states that the
call is being transcribed, offering the called party the chance to decline. This
disclosure is enforced by the service and cannot be removed or overridden — not by
the user, and not by anything placed in task_description or context_notes.

Returns a call_sid, which identifies the call for get_call_status and end_call.

context_notes.description: Extra context the agent may need to complete the task: caller name, account or reservation number, dates, or the desired outcome.
context_notes.title: Context Notes

phone.description: US phone number to dial, E.164 format preferred — for example +15558675309. Common formats such as 555-867-5309 or (555) 867-5309 are also accepted. Non-US numbers are rejected.
phone.title: Phone

task_description.description: What the AI agent should accomplish on the call, in plain language — for example 'Book a table for four on Friday at 7pm.'
task_description.title: Task Description

voice.description: Text-to-speech voice for the AI agent, as aura-2-<name>-<lang>. Default aura-2-asteria-en. -en voices speak English; -es voices speak Spanish, and the ones marked bilingual also speak English and switch to match the other party. English female: asteria (American), helena (American), janus (Southern US), pandora (British), theia (Australian). English male: orpheus (American), arcas (American), zeus (American), draco (British), hyperion (Australian). Spanish female: selena (Latin American, bilingual), diana (Peninsular, bilingual), carina (Peninsular, bilingual), celeste (Colombian), antonia (Argentine). Spanish male: javier (Latin American, bilingual), sirio (Mexican), alvaro (Peninsular), luciano (Mexican), valerio (Mexican).
voice.title: Voice
